nominal_outcome: Represent a two-object useful outcome as one append-only authoritative intent plus one deterministic non-authoritative derived view.

derived_view_contract.projection_rule: Copy intent_id and payload exactly; add view_type=deterministic_projection and authoritative=false. No independent side effect is allowed.
derived_view_contract.replay_rule: Recompute the exact derived-view content from this immutable intent. If exact content is already present, replay is a no-op.
